settings.sub_heading: Hear from Smilie's community who have experienced the life-changing benefits of teeth whitening.

settings.text: I honestly didn't think my teeth could get this white! I was hoping for a bit of a difference, but the results completely blew me away. The whole kit was really easy to use, and I didn't experience any sensitivity, which was a huge bonus. It's given me so much more confidence to smile. I couldn't be happier with the results and would definitely recommend the Boost Whitening Kit to anyone thinking about whitening their teeth!
settings.author: Sarah K, 32 years.

settings.text: Really impressed with the entire process from start to finish. Easy to use system, zero sensitivity and a fast result. I chose this one over others as I like the fact it was developed by dentists. Highly recommend
settings.author: Glen M, 41 years.

settings.text: Exactly as I'd hoped for! I have tried every product in market from supermarket toothpastes to in-chair whitening and nothing, and I mean nothing compares to Smilie's Boost Whitening Kit! It's the perfect balance of giving you the result you're after without leaving you in pain. In chair whitening gives a fast result but its super painful and cheaper products are a waste of time and money. 100% recommend Smilie, don't think - just do!!
settings.author: Olivia R, 28 years.

settings.text: It might sound a bit silly at 68, but I still want to look my best. My teeth were quite stained, as many are at this age and Smilie has made such a difference. What I love most is how simple it is to use, just as the instructions and reviews promised. I was a little nervous at first because I have sensitive teeth, but I’m happy to say it didn’t cause any discomfort at all and the taste was pleasant too. I highly recommend this product to anyone thinking of giving it a go. Thank you, Smilie, for giving me back my confidence!
settings.author: Ruth D, 68 years.

settings.text: I received my smile package yesterday. I used the strips last night and then the toothpaste this morning and already a huge change. I drink coffee a lot and these other toothpastes couldn’t get rid of my stains, I’m so impressed with this product. Can’t wait to use the Boost Kit!
settings.author: Rebecca, 38 years.

settings.text: OMG so impressed with your product. We ordered for our wedding prep and this is the result 10 days in! It was such an easy product to use and we found it easy to keep up with as you can do it from home, in front of the TV our around the house. After my wedding, my husband said the first thing he noticed when I walked down the isle was my smile!
settings.author: Alisha S, 34 years.
